notes.title: Development Update - 6th Oct
notes.notes:
Hello you magnificent gamers,
Thanks for your interest in our game, No Fap Island. We have just released our first playable demo which you can find on the store page. If you are interested in what's more to come, I'll let you in on the secret: the game is planned to be 6 chapters long, each encompassing a day on the island. We have a lot of spicy stuff cooking and can't wait to share more in the future.
If you'd like to follow the game's progress more regularly, please check out [url=https://www.patreon.com/FapYeahGames]our Patreon[/url] for more in depth reports.


Team FapYeah
